title: Phase — Local-First SaaS Startup ($10k MRR)
notes: Scaling Phase from local-first MVP to sustainable $10k MRR privacy-centric planner.

subgoals.title: Milestone 1: Product Foundation & Dogfooding (Alpha)
subgoals: Implement Numeric / Target leaves (F-1) for MRR and interview rollups
Close the estimate vs. actuals completion loop (F-3)
Integrate Google Calendar / iCal busy-block sync (F-12)
Recruit and interview 10 technical founders & 10 STEM student alpha testers
Cut onboarding drop-off rate below 20%

subgoals.title: Milestone 2: Public Launch & Distribution Engine
subgoals: Record high-craft 60-second demo video and GIF walkthroughs
Draft and publish 'Show HN: Phase — Mathematically honest local-first planner'
Coordinate Product Hunt launch day campaign (Aim for Top 3)
Grow GitHub repository to 2,500 stars
Achieve 1,500 weekly active users (WAU)

subgoals.title: Milestone 3: Monetization & Phase Pro Sync
subgoals: Architect zero-knowledge end-to-end encrypted (E2EE) sync engine
Implement Stripe checkout and subscription licensing backend ($10/mo)
Deploy PWA / Mobile quick-capture companion app (F-6)
Launch automated schedule optimizer (Auto-place F-7)
Acquire first 100 paid Pro subscribers ($1,000 MRR)

subgoals.title: Milestone 4: Scale & AI Platform Ecosystem
subgoals: Ship Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for AI agent collaboration
Launch Pair / Team shared blockers ('waiting-on' dependencies)
Scale marketing engine to hit $10,000 monthly recurring revenue (MRR)

title: Web Software House — Client Commission Engine ($15k/mo)
notes: End-to-end agency pipeline: client acquisition, rapid delivery sprints, and recurring retainers.

subgoals.title: Pillar 1: Agency Brand & Client Acquisition Pipeline
subgoals: Design and build agency portfolio site with live case studies & performance audits
Set up inbound lead capture funnel (qualifying budget, timeline, scope)
Package productized offerings: Landing Page ($1.5k), Full Web App ($5k), E-Commerce ($3.5k)
Conduct outbound outreach to 100 local businesses and venture-backed startups
Close and sign first 3 client commission contracts

subgoals.title: Pillar 2: Rapid Delivery & Development Boilerplate
subgoals: Build reusable agency starter stack (React/Next.js, Tailwind, Supabase, Stripe, CMS)
Create Figma UI component library for fast client design mockups
Establish 14-day client delivery sprint pipeline and staging review servers
Prepare client onboarding kit, requirement questionnaire, and handoff documentation

subgoals.title: Pillar 3: Contracts, Invoicing & Financial Operations
subgoals: Draft standard Master Services Agreement (MSA) with 50% upfront deposit terms
Configure Stripe Billing, multi-currency invoicing, and business banking
Reach $10,000 monthly revenue from project commissions
Vet and onboard 1 freelance frontend/design contractor for overflow capacity

subgoals.title: Pillar 4: Retainers & Recurring Revenue Stream
subgoals: Create monthly maintenance, hosting & SEO optimization retainers ($300-$750/mo)
Pitch and sign 5 completed client projects onto monthly maintenance retainers
Achieve $3,000/mo steady recurring retainer revenue
